兜有谱 Tuckora

A care companion that helps elderly parents remember what to bring when going out

Older adults often forget keys, glasses, or medicine on the way out. Tuckora turns a simple voice sentence — "remind me to drink water in 15 minutes" — into a smart going-out checklist, real-time reminders, and a caring loop between parents and their children.

The Problem / The Solution

Why it exists

Built from real daily-life pain points of elderly people living alone or with family.

Elderly going out is stressful

  • 1
    Forget to bring phone, keys, glasses or medicine — the classic "left the house without it" moment
  • 2
    Voice assistants are too complex; most elders can't operate them
  • 3
    Children worry all day and can't know whether their parents arrived safely

Tuckora makes it one sentence

  • ✓
    Tap-to-talk: elder just speaks "remind me to buy groceries" — no complex setup
  • ✓
    Scene-based checklist auto-generates: market, hospital, picking up grandkids…
  • ✓
    Two-way care loop: children see "went out / back home" status, can reply warmly
Product Screens

From onboarding to the care loop

Four key moments of the product, captured from the full 33-screen prototype.

3-Second Onboarding

First-use flow: say a reminder → choose role (elder / child) → pick a going-out scene.

Elder Home & Checklist

Pill-style item states (brought / not yet), weather + family notes, one-tap "I'm leaving".

Child Side & Reply

Today's reminders, receive mom's voice, reply warmly — the emotional loop works both ways.

Status, Push & Privacy

"Dad is out" auto-notify, WeChat subscription push, strict privacy boundary (status only).

Key Features

Designed around elders, not around tech

Voice-first, zero learning curve

"Say it and it's done" — tap-to-talk converts speech into reminders & checklist items.

Scene auto-checklist

Market / hospital / grandkids / walk — the app generates the right packing list per scene.

Flag: pill-state UI, no checkbox symbols

WeChat subscription push

Reminders arrive as system pushes even when the mini-program is closed.

Family care loop

Elders and children remind each other; children reply with warmth, status flows back.

Privacy boundary (P0)

Family sees only going-out status — never the content of private reminders.

Privacy-first by design

Elder-friendly UI system

Large type, high contrast, voice broadcast, warm IP mascot "Doudou" everywhere.
